verdict.rationale: Jules is explicitly a delegatable AI coding agent: users submit tasks via web app, GitHub labels, or API, review a generated plan, and get a PR back (jules-docs-2,4,7,8,9). However, community feedback shows significant caveats—frequent babysitting, infinite loops with no stop button, crashes on complex codebases, and inconsistent code quality—meaning delegation often requires active oversight rather than true autonomous handoff.
